label: git add -A in a flag cluster
switch -c, back to main, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git switch main && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, checkout -B master, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git checkout -B master && git commit -m x

label: commit before switch -c
bash: git commit -m x && git switch -c fix/x

label: commit runs if switch -c fails
bash: git switch -c fix/x || git commit -m x

label: commit after switch -c and ;
bash: git switch -c fix/x; git commit -m x

label: checkout a file then commit
bash: git checkout README.md && git commit -m x

label: switch -c in another repo then commit
bash: git -C ../other switch -c fix/x && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, cd, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && cd ../other && git commit -m x

label: switch -c then add . and commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git add . && git commit -m x

label: switch -c then commit -a
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git commit -am x

label: switch -c, symbolic-ref to main, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/main && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, update-ref HEAD to main, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && git update-ref HEAD refs/heads/main && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, make release, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && make release && git commit -m x

label: switch -c, run a script, commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && ./prep.sh && git commit -m x

label: sed's e flag between the switch and the commit
bash: git switch -c fix/x && sed -n 's/x/git checkout main/e' f && git commit -m x
